import pandas as pd

dates = pd.to_datetime(df['Original air date'], format='%B %d, %Y')

jan_1995 = df[(dates.dt.year == 1995) & (dates.dt.month == 1)]
oct_1994 = df[(dates.dt.year == 1994) & (dates.dt.month == 10)]

n_jan = int(jan_1995['Series #'].count())
n_oct = int(oct_1994['Series #'].count())

if n_jan > n_oct:
    answer = "more"
elif n_jan < n_oct:
    answer = "less"
else:
    answer = "the same"
